newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Wanted Italian drug dealer arrested in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Wanted Italian drug dealer arrested in Brazil.

text.p: An alleged member of Italy's Camorra mafia in Naples who has been living in Brazil has been arrested in Sao Paulo on drug trafficking charges and is awaiting extradition, a police spokesman said Thursday.
Brazilian police acted in response to an extradition request by authorities in Italy, where 52-year-old Michele Vanacore is wanted, the spokesman said.
Vanacore had been living in Rio de Janeiro's beachfront neighbourhood of Copacabana and working as a maintenance man for Italian espresso coffee machines.
He is alleged to be the accomplice of a group of drug dealers arrested in March 1994.
